data.gender_notes: Farouq is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Quran (Quran 25:1), Farouq is an attribute of Allah, denoting His ability to distinguish truth from falsehood. The name Farouq carries the meaning “Discriminator between truth and falsehood” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Farouq usually hope their child will grow to embody discriminator between truth and falsehood and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Farouq belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Discriminator between truth and falsehood.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Farouq total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_english.name: Farouq
in_english.long_meaning: Farouq is an Arabic name derived from the root farq, meaning to distinguish, and refers to a person who can differentiate between right and wrong, and has significant importance in Islamic history as one of the names of Umar ibn Al-Khattab

data.cultural_impact: The name Farouq gained significance due to its association with the great medieval caliph, Al-Farouq, who ruled the Islamic empire in the late 9th and early 10th centuries. During his reign, he established a golden age in Islamic history, characterized by the development of science, art, literature, and lauded for his military prowess. The name was also popular among Sufis (Islamic mystics), as one of the Ninety-Nine Beautiful Names of Allah.
data.spiritual_significance: In the Quran, Allah says to Prophet Muhammad v.53, "O you who believe! Call upon Allah with truth; He will confirm the signs for you. But when He tests you with a affliction, on those days invoke the Name of Allah and remember Him abundantly." Farouq as a name carries the spiritual weight of inspiring its bearer to seek the truth and recognize it, as Allah does, and to rely on the divine power and guidance in times of trial. It is a constant reminder of the importance of honesty, steadfastness, and fathoming the mysteries of the divine.
